quests.title: Smiley's Selections

dialogue.t: Yes, that's my commission. Have you already prepared two strips of Bacon?
Alright, this Bacon should be enough. The cheapskate won't be able to eat much anyway...
Oh, before I forget... Here's your payment.

quests.description: Wangshu Inn’s Smiley Yanxiao needs two strips of Bacon.
